title: Homelab Infrastructure Shape
description: Declarative shape of a unit of homelab infrastructure provisioned by the C#-native engine / community-scripts renderer. See ADR-0001. kind: Stack groups LXC members and carries a CTID range + inheritable defaults; kind: LXC describes a container with the full Proxmox surface (most fields optional). The community-scripts create path (Deploy-Shape.ps1) honours a subset; the rest is converge-only (ProxmoxSharp, BL-010).

apiVersion.description: Schema version. Bumped when the shape contract changes.

kind.description: What this shape describes. 'Node' is a physical Proxmox host (described, not provisioned). 'Stack' groups LXC/VM members and owns a CTID range + defaults.

name.description: Stable, human-readable identifier (e.g. 'forgejo'). For LXC this drives the hostname unless spec.hostname overrides it.

stack.description: Owning stack (matches a kind: Stack metadata.name, e.g. 'devops'). Omit for hub-owned (non-stack) infra. Member inherits that stack's spec.defaults.

tags.description: Free-form labels (mirrors Proxmox tags). Note: a 'vlan-1010' tag here is UI ceremony only — the real VLAN tag lives in spec.network.vlan.

description.description: Optional human note about this shape.

spec.description: Kind-specific desired state. Constrained per-kind via the allOf branches below (LXC and Stack are strict; Node/VM/NASShare stay permissive until their contracts are tightened).

allOf.description: app + ctid are mandatory for a deployable LXC (ctid omission is an error — no silent allocation). node/os/network may be inherited from the stack, so they are not required on the member itself.

source.description: Where the community-scripts ct/<app>.sh is fetched from.

channel.description: stable → community-scripts/ProxmoxVE ; dev → community-scripts/ProxmoxVED (in-development scripts, e.g. forgejo-runner).

repo.description: Explicit 'owner/repo' override. Takes precedence over channel when set (escape hatch).

ref.description: Git ref (branch/tag/commit SHA) to pull the script from. Pin a SHA for reproducibility — dev-channel scripts move.

features.description: Proxmox LXC features (var_* equivalents on the community-scripts path: nesting→var_nesting, fuse→var_fuse).

keyctl.description: Expose keyctl() — needed by some Alpine/systemd workloads.

mount.description: Filesystem types the container may mount itself (e.g. ['nfs','cifs']). See the NFS placement exploration before enabling — in-container NFS is mount-race prone.

up.description: Seconds to wait after start before starting the next.

down.description: Seconds to wait on shutdown before forcing.

tty.description: Number of TTYs available to the container.

networkInterface.description: A single Proxmox netX interface (full surface). Used in spec.networks[]. NOTE: the community-scripts create path provisions only one NIC — use spec.network for that; spec.networks is for converge (ProxmoxSharp).

name.description: Interface name inside the container (e.g. 'eth0' or 'vlan1010').

tag.description: VLAN tag applied on the bridge (the real VLAN — e.g. 1010).

firewall.description: Enable the Proxmox firewall on this interface.

hwaddr.description: MAC address (pin for stable DHCP leases).

network.description: Primary NIC, homelab-friendly sugar. This is what the community-scripts create path honours (→ var_brg/var_vlan/var_net/var_gateway/var_ipv6_method/var_mtu). For new CTs the renderer emits a single tagged interface name=vlan<vlan>,bridge=<bridge>,tag=<vlan>,ip=<ipv4>.

vlan.description: Real VLAN tag (→ var_vlan, interface tag=).

mount.description: A storage mount (Proxmox mpX). NOTE: the community-scripts create path does NOT provision mounts — these are applied by ProxmoxSharp converge (BL-010). See docs/plans/BL-016-nfs-hardening.md.

type.description: nfs = NAS export, host-level via a Proxmox NFS storage rendered as a storage-backed mpN (gated on storage health) — NEVER mounted inside the guest (BL-016). bind = host path; volume = Proxmox storage volume; device = block device.

storage.description: For type: nfs/volume — the Proxmox storage id (e.g. 'ds1813-nfs-volume-3'). A storage-referenced volume is what lets Proxmox gate CT start on storage availability.

source.description: Volume id, host path, or (for type: nfs) a subpath under the storage's host mount. A raw path bind is NOT storage-gated — prefer a storage volume for app-owned data (BL-016).

size.description: Volume size for type: volume / a newly-allocated nfs volume (e.g. '8G').

shared.description: Marked available on all nodes (does not create it).

device.description: Host device passthrough (Proxmox devX), e.g. a USB serial or /dev/dri for transcoding.

rootfsOptions.description: Extra options for the root volume (size/storage are spec.disk/spec.storage).

lxcRaw.description: Escape hatch: raw lxc.* config lines emitted verbatim (e.g. cgroup device allows, custom mount entries). Use when no first-class field exists.

secret.description: A secret the converge engine resolves at provision time and feeds to the app's post-create step. NEVER inline a secret value — only references/derivation verbs are committed.

secretSource.description: Exactly ONE of: env (pre-existing secret from secrets.env), service (derived from another shape at provision time), or provider (derived from an external API).

env.description: (a) Pre-existing — resolve from the gitignored secrets.env by this env var name (e.g. 'GH_RUNNER_PAT', 'CF_API_TOKEN').

service.description: (b) Derived — mint by invoking an action on another shape in the stack (e.g. Forgejo CLI 'generate-runner-token').

ref.description: Name of the providing shape (should also appear in spec.dependsOn).

provider.description: (c) Derived — mint from an external provider API (e.g. GitHub org runner token, Cloudflare tunnel token).

auth.description: How to authenticate to the provider — typically { env: <PAT name> }.

lxcSpec.description: Desired state for a Proxmox LXC. Only metadata.name + spec.ctid + spec.app are practically needed for the community-scripts create path; everything else has a sane default or is converge-only.

node.description: Target Proxmox node (e.g. 'desktop-01'). Required to deploy; may be inherited from the stack's defaults.

app.description: community-scripts slug selecting ct/<app>.sh (e.g. 'forgejo', 'forgejo-runner', 'github-runner', 'docker', 'debian'). Required for the community-scripts create path.

ctid.description: Container ID. REQUIRED — omission is an error (no silent allocation). Use an integer (the norm; validated to fall within the owning stack's ctidRange), or the literal 'auto' to draw the next free ID from the stack range (the rare, explicit exception).

os.description: Base OS / template distro (→ var_os; Proxmox ostype). e.g. 'debian', 'alpine', 'ubuntu'.

unprivileged.description: Unprivileged container (→ var_unprivileged). Note: NFS/CIFS mounts inside an unprivileged CT need extra capabilities — prefer host-level.

storage.description: Proxmox storage for the root volume (→ var_container_storage), e.g. 'local-lvm'.

templateStorage.description: Storage holding the OS template (→ var_template_storage), e.g. 'local'.

networks.description: Full multi-NIC list (net0..netN), converge-only. Use spec.network for the single-NIC community-scripts path.

nameserver.description: DNS server IP (→ var_ns). Defaults to host setting.

mounts.description: Storage mounts — post-create / converge (NOT provisioned by community-scripts).

pool.description: Proxmox resource pool to place the CT in.

hookscript.description: Volume path to a lifecycle hook script (e.g. for host-mount ordering).

sshAuthorizedKey.description: Public key to inject (→ var_ssh_authorized_key). Enables var_ssh.

tags.description: Labels merged into metadata.tags (→ var_tags). Mainly used in a Stack's spec.defaults to apply common labels to every member; a member normally uses metadata.tags.

dependsOn.description: Names of shapes that must converge first. Converge-only (BL-010): the engine topologically orders by this, and a dependency's resolved attributes (e.g. URL/IP) become available to this shape's config/secrets.

config.description: App-specific post-create settings the converge engine's provisioner applies (e.g. forgejo { rootUrl }, github-runner { githubOrg }, cloudflared { tunnel, ingress }). NOT touched by the community-scripts create path.

secrets.description: Secrets the converge engine resolves at provision time (from secrets.env, another service, or a provider) and feeds to the post-create step. Converge-only; never provisioned by community-scripts.

stackSpec.description: A stack groups members and owns a CTID range + inheritable defaults. Members reference it via metadata.stack.

ctidRange.description: Reserved CTID block. Explicit member ctids MUST fall within [start,end] (else error); 'ctid: auto' draws the next free ID from here.

defaults.description: Default LXC spec values inherited by members of this stack. Member values override. (Reuses the LXC spec shape; all fields optional here.)
